organization.name: Azra Analytics
organization.summary: Strategy-driven data and AI development firm. We connect business strategy, workflow design, data engineering, machine learning, and AI application development to improve how organizations operate and decide.
organization.positioning: Strategy-driven. Open-source-first. Built for your operating environment.
organization.location: Based in Michigan, United States. Works with organizations internationally.

engagement_model: Services function as one connected cycle: strategy informs decisions, data engineering builds foundations, machine learning generates insights, and AI applications embed those insights into workflows. Engagements range from focused projects to comprehensive transformations.

services.name: Strategy and Workflow Design
services.problem_solved: Organizations know AI matters but cannot tell which workflows, decisions, or operational problems are actually worth investing in.
services.description: We identify the workflows, decisions, and operational challenges where data, machine learning, and AI can create measurable value, then translate those opportunities into a practical implementation roadmap.
services.ideal_client: Leaders with fragmented data and several candidate AI ideas who need a defensible sequence and business case before committing budget.

services.name: Data Ingestion & Engineering
services.problem_solved: Data is scattered across systems, spreadsheets, and documents, is inconsistently structured, and cannot be trusted for reporting or modeling.
services.description: We connect fragmented data sources and build reliable pipelines, data models, and analytical foundations. The result is trusted, accessible data that can support reporting, machine learning, and AI applications.
deliverables: Structured data models and warehouse layer
services.ideal_client: Operations and analytics teams whose reporting breaks because source data is manual, duplicated, or spread across many systems.

services.name: Machine Learning
services.problem_solved: A recurring, high-value decision is being made with intuition or simple rules when historical data could support it.
services.description: We develop predictive and analytical models built around specific business decisions, from forecasting and anomaly detection to risk assessment, optimization, and operational planning.
services.ideal_client: Teams with a clearly defined decision, a source of ground-truth history, and the ability to act on a model's output.

services.name: AI Application Development
services.problem_solved: Insights and models exist but are not embedded where work actually happens, so they do not change day-to-day behavior.
services.description: We build practical AI applications that integrate models, organizational knowledge, and human judgment into everyday workflows: intelligent assistants, recommendation systems, document-processing tools, and custom decision-support applications.
deliverables: Custom decision-support applications with human-in-the-loop review
services.ideal_client: Organizations that have a proven insight or manual process and want it delivered as a dependable application with auditability and human oversight.
